newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul blue chips likely to continue consolidation.
newsitem.headline: Seoul blue chips likely to continue consolidation.

text.p: SEOUL, July 10 (Reute) - Seoul stocks are likely to fall on Thursday due to continued consolidation of blue chips while smaller capitalised stocks are seen gaining, brokers said.
"Investors are hesitating as they see no more brisk signs on the economy after brisk June trade figures sparked a rally last week," said Koh Kyung-bae of Hyundai Securities.
Brokers said small-cap stocks, especially in the pharmaceutical, paper and electrical sectors, would benefit from rotational buying.
The composite index rose 4.25 points to 771.99 on Wednesday.
